Toddler meals

Yogurt porridge

Joghurtos zabkása

6 months+ Sound idea 15 min 2 portions

Serve warm in a bowl. The yogurt goes in after cooking, so make it fresh rather than freezing it.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 40 g Rolled oats (Cooked until soft)
  • 200 ml Water (For cooking the oats)
  • 60 g Plain full-fat yogurt (Pasteurized; stirred in off the heat)

Allergens

glutenmilk

Method

  1. Simmer the oats in the water until soft.
  2. Take the pan off the heat.
  3. Cool the porridge a little, until it is warm rather than hot.
  4. Stir in the plain yogurt.
  5. Serve straight away.

Sound idea

Sweetened yogurt would add sugar this bowl does not need. The oats should be cooked in water, not stirred in raw.

Cook the oats in water, cool them a little, and stir in plain full-fat yogurt.
